results.source: Washington State Department of Health, Health Care Provider Credential Data (data.wa.gov dataset qxh8-f4bd), CSV from the open-data API, four credential types: Dentist License, Dental Hygiene License, Veterinary License, Veterinary Technician License
results.found: 47539 credentials (20881 with a board status starting "Active"): 25972 not active at the board, 12 past their expiry date (12 of them still "Active" at the board), 3650 expiring within 90 days, 438 with no expiry date.
results.false_positives: none against the recount (all status counts equal); the 12 "Active" credentials past their date are not wrong findings but a disagreement inside the board's own file, which the agent now says in the detail
results.changed: Before this pass the agent could not read the file at all (no holder column: the board splits first and last name) and ignored the board status. It now joins first and last name, reads the status column, reports not_active when the board says expired, closed, suspended and the like, and says when the board still lists a past-date credential as Active.

results.source: Nevada Medicaid sample 835 file (published as a PDF for providers; text extracted with pdftotext, page lines removed and wrapped segments rejoined)
results.licence: State of Nevada public provider document; no licence stated; names and ids in it are sample values
results.ran: era_check with an empty posting file
results.found: 3 remittances (segments ended by line breaks, not "~"), 3 claims: 2 denials to work (claim status 4, CO-26), 1 claim processed as secondary with nothing paid (left as ok), and a 1812.27 payment made only of provider-level adjustments (PLB, -1812.27 in total) with no claims on it.
results.changed: Before this pass the claim-less payment and every provider-level (PLB) adjustment were dropped without a word: the 1,812.27 check was not in the result. The agent now lists each check with PLB adjustments as provider_adjustment (post at the account level) and shows the payment amount and PLB total per check.

results.source: CMS NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) 2026, data.medicaid.gov dataset fbb83258-11c7-47f5-8b18-5f8e79f7e704, rows for 26 human generics often dispensed by veterinary practices, as of 2026-01-07 and 2026-11-18
results.ran: pharmacy_check on a price list whose Cost and Previous Cost are the median NADAC per unit on the two dates and whose prices are fictional (2.2 times the January cost, unchanged)
results.found: 26 drugs: 6 cost more per unit in November than in January, 20 less. 3 rose by more than 5% with the price unchanged (METRONIDAZOLE 250 MG TABLET 0.0623 to 0.12371; ENALAPRIL MALEATE 5 MG TABLET 0.07154 to 0.08362; TRAMADOL HCL 50 MG TABLET 0.02368 to 0.02569), 1 fell under the 45% margin, 0 priced below cost. Unit costs with five decimals (0.02152) were read without rounding.
results.changed: Nothing: the rules and the reader gave the same counts as the recount. NADAC covers human drugs only, so veterinary products (carprofen, maropitant) are not in it.

results.source: Montana Medicaid (DPHHS) dental services fee schedules, January 2026 (revised) and July 2025, Excel files from medicaidprovider.mt.gov
results.licence: State of Montana public provider document; CDT codes and descriptors are copyright of the American Dental Association
results.ran: fees_check with each schedule as one plan (plan argument) against the fictional 8-code office fee list from the fixtures
results.found: January2026DentalServicesFeeSchedule_rev.xlsx (sheet "Oral Surgeon Services", fee column "Office Fees"): 285 codes read; July2025DentalServicesFeeSchedule.xlsx (sheet "Dental", fee column "Fees"): 281 codes read. Against the 8 fictional office fees: 6 codes with a write-off over 45%, 0 with the office fee below the plan's, 277 schedule codes the office has no fee for (listed as not_offered). Every code row has a numeric fee.
results.changed: Before this pass the agent could not read either file: a payer publishes one plan per file with no plan column, and names the columns Proc and Fees (July 2025) or Office Fees (January 2026, also a renamed sheet). It now takes a plan argument and those names. It would also have raised one "no office fee" finding for each of the schedule codes the office never bills; those are now listed as not_offered and are not counted as work.
